business: Meridian Testing Laboratories, Inc. (Environmental & Materials Testing Laboratory)

expectedRedFlags: Customer concentration: Largest customer, Skagit Logistics, is 20.1% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 57.0%.
expectedYellowFlags: Owner compensation normalization: Substantially supportable. $103,000 of the $118,000 claim exceeds market compensation for the technical director role the owner actually performs.
ISO 17025 reaccreditation project: Fully supportable. Reaccreditation is a discrete multi-year cycle event and the ledger shows activity only in April and June 2025.
Former CFO severance: Fully supportable as a non-recurring cost. Two payments in May and June 2025 with nothing before or after.
Laboratory relocation and build-out: Fully supportable. The move to the Nampa facility occurred in July and August 2025 and the costs are confined to those two months.

Replacement CFO run-rate cost (buyer adjustment): Buyer-identified downward adjustment of $41,000. The CFO role has been vacant since June 2025, so the TTM carries only a partial year of that cost. Run-rate EBITDA must absorb a full year of the replacement.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $147,308 to $257,113; cash ranges from $3,652,291 to $4,819,753. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
groundTruth.notes: MML M&A Benchmark Deal DD-009: Meridian Testing Laboratories, Inc. (Environmental & Materials Testing Laboratory). Seller claims $2.95M EBITDA vs $2.89M buyer-supported ($56k overstatement).

expectedCrossDocumentConflicts.description: Seller-claimed adjusted EBITDA of $2,950,000 overstates the buyer-supported $2,892,719 by $57,281 (~2%).
